snippet.title: Scrap Slot Arena - Trailer | Coming Soon to Steam
snippet.description:
A roguelite where a slot machine builds your scrap robot, then you watch a 15-second physics auto-battle.

Spin a slot machine built from scrap, and the five parts it lands on become your robot. Reroll up to twice, then watch a 15-second physics brawl unfold. Win and your machine fights on; lose and it is back to junk. Topple three leagues and their Kings to relight the last arena.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5352950/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_content=trailer

Release date: December 2, 2026
Platforms: Windows / macOS (Steam)
Price: US $7.99 (20% off, $6.39, for the first week)
Developer / Publisher: GarageNova

Streaming & video guidelines: https://garage-nova.com/en/guidelines
